title: Concept: OAuth implicit flow in a response
description: An authorisation request that uses response_type=token in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The implicit flow returns the access token in the URL fragment, where it is written to history and readable by any script on the page; the code flow with PKCE replaced it for this reason.
applicability: Partner integrations, mobile web views and legacy single sign-on pages.
risk: A token in the fragment leaks through history, screenshots and any script on the redirect page.
